validated_properties: Oct-Dec observations map to the same austral breeding-season start year and Jan-Mar to the preceding year; Apr-Sep fail closed.
Band inventory uniquely recovers natal colony and cohort; overlapping intervals fail closed.
PB, BR, NB and ambiguous multi-colony breeding states are reconstructed from documented Eggs/Chicks codes.
Prior Beaufort breeding prevents a later Ross observation from being treated as first reproduction.
Chicks=9-only checks remain unknown rather than failure.
Banded-breeder chick-presence performance is one value per breeder-season and requires complete three-colony years.
Source first-breeding events are separated from the multi-candidate choice-model subset.
Canonical detection observations preserve individual, date, colony and observer fields without reading a real CSV.
Source-gate eligibility can retain one-candidate events before the frozen >=2 candidate choice filter.
V2 choice rows require complete three-colony performance, colony-size controls, and finite event-specific resight-day detection proxies.
Events with missing candidate controls are excluded as whole events rather than partially repaired.
